patterns.note: Sections often feature full-bleed dark backgrounds with content centered or left-aligned, using large typography as the primary visual element, creating a gallery-like presentation.
The site employs an extreme typographic scale, featuring massive, condensed display headings that dominate sections, contrasting sharply with smaller, more conventional sans-serif body text.

A stark, high-contrast color palette of black and various shades of grey is consistently used for backgrounds and text, punctuated by a distinct, muted neon green for accents and highlighted elements.
The main product name 'Timeline' in the hero section dynamically transforms through different weights and sizes as the user scrolls, creating a live demonstration of the typeface's versatility.

Content is organized into distinct, full-screen visual experiences, such as dedicated sections for showcasing individual glyphs or typographic features, rather than traditional text-heavy content blocks.

technique_notes: A persistent header remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing continuous access to navigation and key calls to action as the user scrolls.

The hero section utilizes scroll-triggered animation to progressively reveal and morph large text elements, effectively turning the product's visual attributes into an interactive, on-page demonstration.
New content sections are introduced with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, ensuring a smooth and engaging transition between different parts of the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed display headings (up to ~8x body text) create a dramatic visual impact, while body text is set in a clear, readable sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, emphasizing a modern, technical aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and large negative space around display typography, creating a sense of grandeur and focus.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its audacious and dynamic use of typography as the primary visual and interactive element. The scroll-triggered transformation of the 'Timeline' typeface demonstration turns the product itself into the hero experience, making it genuinely unique.
